correctness.rationale: In each rook graph K_m□K_n (m,n>=2), maximal geodesics are precisely three-cell right-angle L paths, so at most floor(mn/3) can be vertex-disjoint. The 2×2,2×3,3×3 and 4×4 constructions plus strip decompositions cover all dimension residues and attain the ceiling. In K_2□K_n each L comprises a full pivot column and a wing cell in another column: choosing k pivot columns, distributing wing rows and injective wing columns gives the stated P_n polynomial. The unused cells admit no L iff either (a) there is no fully empty nonpivot column or (b) the only empty cells are exactly one full nonpivot column. This yields the given M_n polynomial including its n≡1 mod3 exceptional coefficient and all maximal cardinalities ceil(n/2)...floor(2n/3). The maximum counts follow by substitution; all n>=2 boundaries and path reversal convention handled. Independently enumerated all two-row packings and inclusion-maximal subsets for n=2..6.
residual_risks: Finite packing enumeration n<=6 cannot prove all n; infinite count is justified by the bijection and uncovered-cell characterization.

originality.rationale: Earlier complete Resultary papers cover two major parts: Oct 13 proves the all-rectangle packing number floor(mn/3), and Nov 2 proves the exact all-packing polynomial and residue-dependent maximum counts for two rows. Those are expressly NOT novel here. The distinct surviving claim is a COMPLETE polynomial enumerating inclusion-maximal geodesic packings (not merely all or maximum packings), the exact gap-free maximal-size support, and the exceptional empty-column family. Neither earlier full RESULT.md gives this maximal-set enumerator; the Manuel–Brešar–Klavžar source introduces the invariant and bounds but not its explicit classification. Best-of-knowledge novelty qualified against broader induced P3-packing literature.
residual_risks: Equivalent inclusion-maximal induced three-vertex-path hypergraph matchings could have appeared in less searchable combinatorial literature; best-of-knowledge assessment, not priority certification.

value.rationale: The inclusion-maximal geodesic-packing polynomial enumerates ALL saturated rather than merely maximum families on a natural standard rook graph. Its exact distribution and gap-free spectrum identify how far greedy/saturated packings can fall below optimal and the exceptional full-unoccupied-column family. This is a natural complete classification and potentially reusable combinatorial invariant; its significance does not rest on the previously known maximum packing number or all-packing polynomial.
residual_risks: General-height inclusion-maximal enumerators are not claimed; no mathematical necessity of extending the result to every rectangle.

limitations: Only the novel inclusion-maximal two-row polynomial, support and exceptional correction merit credit. Packing-number theorem and all-packing two-row polynomial/maximal count already published. A possible equivalent induced-P3 matching enumeration remains historical risk.
